cohort: 8,407 mothers and their newborns admitted to the County Emergency Hospital, Tîrgu-Mureş, Romania, between 2008 and 2011
finding: The study found a significant increase in preterm deliveries, twinning rate, and cesarean delivery incidence, alongside a decrease in mean gestational age and fetal weight, and a higher incidence of comorbidities and pregnancy-related complications in women aged 35 and above.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery incidence increased from 46.3% to 51.0% in women aged ≥ 35.
